The Intel® FPGA Self-Service Licensing Center (SSLC) is upgrading to a new location on the altera.com domain. To ensure a smooth transition of your data, the current site will not accept new license requests from February 23rd through March 15th. You will still be able to create evaluation and no-cost licenses on the intel.com SSLC during this time.
